verdict.rationale: Docusign documents central storage of agreements and AI-powered finding and analysis of them on its IAM platform. Its MCP connector guide also describes retrieving agreement metadata and querying key dates, which implies metadata exists on stored agreements. However, no evidence explicitly describes automatic extraction of key terms from executed contracts or a searchable repository UI with metadata fields. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automated key-term/metadata extraction on executed contracts, detail on repository search and filtering capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can store executed contracts in a searchable repository with key terms and metadata extracted
